investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stonehollow Labs (collaboration SaaS); Platform: Google Cloud europe-west4 (zones europe-west4-a/europe-west4-b/europe-west4-c); network range 10.116.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stoneh-prod-europe (GKE); Database: postgres server search-db-01 reachable from the application network only through firewall rule allow-search-to-db; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
